Title: Event Hubs on Azure Stack Hub for disconnected scenarios is now generally available

Body.Content:
Event Hubs is a reliable and scalable event streaming engine that backs thousands of applications across every kind of industry in Microsoft Azure. We are now announcing the general availability of Event Hubs on Azure Stack Hub for disconnected scenarios. For more information on pricing for disconnected operating mode, please consult the Azure Stack Hub Pricing page.

General availability announcement of Event Hubs on Azure Stack Hub.

Read the Event Hubs documentation.

Learn more.
